title: Kissed Egyptian Date Tagine
description: Nutty, gooey, and rich, this Egyptian dish is perfect for a romantic date night. Use egg-free-friendly ingredients to make it suitable for all dietary needs.

ingredients.name: pitted dates
ingredients.notes: Medjool dates work well in this recipe

ingredients.name: almond butter
ingredients.notes: use creamy almond butter for best results

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.notes: adjust to taste for sweetness level

ingredients.name: shio-cure flounder fillets
ingredients.notes: substitute with any firm white fish

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375° F (190° C).
In a blender or food processor, combine almond butter, honey, and 1/2 cup of coconut milk to make the date paste.
Cut the shio-cure flounder fillets into small pieces and set aside.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the blended date paste to the saucepan with melted butter and stir until combined.
Add the fish pieces to the saucepan and stir to coat with the date paste mixture.
Transfer the saucepan to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup of chilled coconut milk and adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve the Kissed Egyptian Date Tagine warm, garnished with fresh herbs or edible flowers if desired.
